module_summary: Five-state Moore FSM detecting serial pattern 1101 on data, then latching in Done state to assert start_shifting until reset.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: Sequence-detector state register S..Done; next state chosen by data bit

anchors.name: start_shifting
anchors.why: Level output decoded from Done state, held until reset

anchors.name: data
anchors.why: Serial input bit stream steering every FSM transition

groups.name: pattern_detector_fsm
groups.description: Detects 1101 in serial data and asserts start_shifting forever
